reviews.text: Truly professional and empathetic with all animals. Highly recommended!

We took Maggy, our dachshund, to Dr. Vicla as soon as she got her new dog. She immediately empathized with Maggy, was helpful, and meticulous, and managed to free her from her initial fears of fitting into city life. She's always attentive and available.
The doctor is always very attentive and helpful, very sweet with her patients, we have been relying on her for 11 years, I recommend her!

Dr. Sgaravatti has been treating Ginger since she arrived home three years ago. Her visits are a pleasure, with thorough answers and lots of advice for those of us who are anxious and have never gotten a pet. She's always available, attentive, and thorough—a guarantee.

I've been taking my cats to Dr. Sgaravatti for years and have always been very satisfied: she's available, professional, punctual, and takes great care to keep the cats as calm as possible during visits.

Inappropriate prices: €50 for the registration certificate (it wasn't even printed), €75 for a vaccination.
Everything was very slow, not recommended.
I immediately found Dr. Vicla Sgaravatti to be competent, very knowledgeable and empathetic.

I immediately liked Dr. Vicla, first and foremost for the way she welcomed my cat and the way she treated him so diligently. I found her very helpful and attentive.
Not to mention her willingness to talk and exchange opinions about my furry friend's personality. I'll be bringing my second cat there soon!
